description: Hochsauerlandkreis Wasserschutzgebiete (Atom-Feed) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis-rest.nrw.de. The portal shows the English title as "Hochsauerlandkreis Water protection areas (nuclear feed)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include HSK, Wasserschutzgebiete, Hochsauerlandkreis, WSG, Atom-Feed. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
